meta.name: image-enhancer
meta.description: Improves the quality of images, especially screenshots, by enhancing resolution, sharpness, and clarity. Perfect for preparing images for presentations, documentation, or social media posts.

copy.tagline: 提升图片分辨率、锐度和清晰度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把截图或低清图片变得清晰锐利
copy.tagline_en: Enhance image resolution, sharpness, and clarity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make screenshots or low-res images crisp and clear

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析并提升图片质量，包括提高分辨率、锐化细节、减少压缩噪点，并针对网页、打印或社交媒体等用途优化图片。
howto.when: 当你上传图片或截图，并明确要求改善画质、提升分辨率或锐化时触发。

say.text: 帮我提升这张截图的清晰度。
say.note: Claude 会分析并增强截图。

say.text: 把这个图片放大到4K分辨率。

say.note: Claude 会增强边缘和细节。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can analyze and improve image quality by upscaling resolution, sharpening details, reducing compression artifacts, and optimizing for web, print, or social media.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload an image or screenshot and explicitly ask to improve quality, upscale, or sharpen.

say_en.text: Enhance the clarity of this screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and enhance the screenshot.
Claude will enhance edges and details.
